description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取大陆公募基金的场内份额及场外份额数据。可按基金代码、时间范围进行筛选，返回日期、总份额（场内+场外）、总资产规模、场内份额、场内资产规模等数据。当用户想查询某公募基金的份额变化、场内场外份额分布时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain exchange-traded and off-exchange share data for A-share funds (LOF and some closed-end funds). Filters can be applied by fund code and date range, returning fields such as date, total shares (exchange + off-exchange), total asset scale, exchange-traded shares, and exchange-traded asset scale (LOF funds and some closed-end funds have both exchange and off-exchange shares). Call this interface when users want to query the share changes of a fund or the distribution between exchange-traded and off-exchange shares.

instruction: LOF基金和一些封闭式基金有场内份额和场外份额。
